selection_rule: Candidates 41 through 45 in deterministic unresolved-candidate universe order after 40 sealed dispositions.

material_dependency_test.basis: The VI.B.1 assessment supplies the improved-process context, critical characteristics, monitoring needs, responsible roles, and response constraints needed to construct a control plan. It does not require prior execution of the separate VI.A.3 chart-selection and interpretation capability.

dispositions.rationale: Control charts can be components of a control plan, but the bounded plan target supplies its monitoring needs directly and does not require a chart-selection performance first. The relation is operationally useful but not a mandatory capability gate.

material_dependency_test.basis: The VI.B.2 assessment supplies process documents and revision records with version, approval, access, traceability, and supersession evidence or gaps. Document-control integrity can be classified without first constructing a control plan under VI.B.1.

dispositions.rationale: Control plans are documents that may themselves require control, but the document-control capability is independently assessable from supplied revision evidence. Source adjacency does not establish a mandatory prerequisite.

material_dependency_test.basis: The VI.B.3 assessment directly supplies the process change, target roles, required capabilities, constraints, and verification needs required to construct or evaluate a training plan. A separately constructed VI.B.1 control plan is not required.

dispositions.rationale: A control plan can identify training needs in practice, but the qualified training target begins with those needs already supplied. A hard prerequisite would encode one workflow source of training requirements rather than capability dependence.

material_dependency_test.basis: VI.B.4 is a REMEMBER-level audit concept target requiring recall of audit purpose and the role of evidence in a bounded control-phase context. It does not require prior performance of VI.B.2 document-control classification.

dispositions.rationale: Controlled documentation can support a real audit, but recalling the audit concept is independently performable and explicitly does not require a specific audit record set. The hard prerequisite is therefore unsupported.

material_dependency_test.basis: The VI.B.5 assessment supplies a bounded improvement or control problem, explicit current evidence, constraints, and proposed next actions. The learner can organize those actions into PDCA without first constructing a separate VI.B.1 control plan.

dispositions.rationale: Control planning and PDCA can interact during sustained improvement, but the qualified PDCA target is independently executable from its supplied problem evidence. The relationship does not meet the hard-prerequisite threshold.
